## Proverb ID
The proverb ID or row identifier from the dataset (e.g., `proverb_001`).

## Language
The language of the affected proverb or MCQ (e.g., `en`, `ar`, `yo`).

## Issue Type
- [ ] Wrong gold meaning
- [ ] Offensive distractor
- [ ] Duplicate options
- [ ] Language mismatch
- [ ] Formatting

## Description
A clear and concise description of the data issue.

## Severity
- [ ] Low
- [ ] Medium
- [ ] High
